name: KGB
recent: Kelington Group Berhad 近期在砂拉越古晋连续获得三份合约，总额达 RM544 million，涉及数据存储厂房项目。最新一份为 RM128 million 合约，于两周内第三度中标。公司亦有多名董事及高管在公开市场及闭门期内外申报买卖股份。
notable: 公司获得古晋数据存储厂房项目合约，两周内三份合约总额达 RM544 million。
最新一份合约为 RM128 million，由子公司获得。
risks: 多名董事及高管在闭门期内申报有意进行股份交易。
集团首席运营官在闭门期内以每股 RM6.760 增持 20,000 股。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 RM344.4 million，环比增长27.4%，同比增长22.1%；净利为 RM41.3 million，环比增长36.0%，同比增长25.7%；净利率为12.0%，高于上一季度的11.2%。

recent_en: Kelington Group Berhad recently secured three contracts in Kuching, Sarawak, totaling RM544 million for a data storage plant project. The latest is a RM128 million contract, its third win in two weeks. Several directors and senior management also reported share dealings both outside and during the closed period.
notable_en: The company secured contracts for a data storage plant project in Kuching, with three contracts totaling RM544 million within two weeks.
The latest contract is worth RM128 million and was secured by a subsidiary.
risks_en: Several directors and senior management have declared intentions to deal in shares during the closed period.
The Group Chief Operating Officer acquired 20,000 shares at RM6.760 per share during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM344.4 million, up 27.4% QoQ and 22.1% YoY; net profit was RM41.3 million, up 36.0% QoQ and 25.7% YoY; net margin was 12.0%, higher than 11.2% in the previous quarter.
